title: leucantha iberica
intro: Leucantha iberica, commonly known as the "saxaul" or "saksaul", is a shrub-like plant native to the deserts and steppes of Central Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. Leucantha iberica contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
